role_repair_analysis.node_purpose: Let five owning specialists reconsider only the seven independently rejected financial propositions.
role_repair_analysis.input_scale: One immutable role workpaper, role-local context, feedback receipts and unchanged authority sets per role.
role_repair_analysis.required_outputs: One substantive revised natural draft per role resolving every assigned finding without invented facts.
role_repair_analysis.schema_burden: Repair context carries prior judgment, affected surfaces and immutable evidence, numeric, relation and gap references.
role_repair_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: Very high because contribution, cohort, stock-flow, product scope and cross-company boundaries affect financial truth.
role_repair_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R5 completed the same workpaper topology at 32000 tokens; R6 stopped locally before any Provider call.
role_repair_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max with max_tokens 32000 for genuine financial reconsideration.
role_repair_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One draft per role and zero retry; failure consumes R7 and preserves the previous valid workpaper.

role_repair_submission.node_purpose: Map each repair draft into the strict specialist Workpaper contract without strengthening its judgment.
role_repair_submission.input_scale: One repair draft plus compact submission view, prior workpaper, feedback and locked reference authority.
role_repair_submission.required_outputs: One valid repaired workpaper per role with every authority reference set unchanged.
role_repair_submission.schema_burden: Nested thesis, claims, mechanism, alternatives, counterarguments and change conditions remain role-local.
role_repair_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapper error could erase a correction or smuggle new authority, so exact local comparison is required.
role_repair_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R5 strict submissions succeeded with this non-thinking profile; R6 made zero Provider attempts.
role_repair_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled with max_tokens 8000 because analysis already exists.
role_repair_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One Tool Call per role and zero retry; invalid JSON, new references or truncation fail closed.

lead_recheck_analysis.node_purpose: Compare five repaired workpapers with unchanged Supply before independent reassessment.
lead_recheck_analysis.input_scale: Six validated workpapers after seven bound findings and no new evidence or data authority.
lead_recheck_analysis.required_outputs: One materiality-ranked Lead draft that proceeds or identifies a catalog-bound unresolved challenge.
lead_recheck_analysis.schema_burden: Lead may select only challenges compiled from the six current workpapers and cannot author facts.
lead_recheck_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: A false proceed repeats R5 semantic failure while an unbounded loop overfits the workflow.
lead_recheck_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R5 Lead completed naturally but missed seven errors; R6 did not reach the Provider frontier.
lead_recheck_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max with max_tokens 32000 for cross-role financial comparison.
lead_recheck_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One natural Lead draft and zero retry; off-catalog or truncated output preserves the frontier.

lead_recheck_submission.node_purpose: Map the Lead recheck into the strict catalog-bound decision without changing its routing judgment.
lead_recheck_submission.input_scale: One Lead draft plus deterministic challenge catalog derived from six post-repair workpapers.
lead_recheck_submission.required_outputs: One valid accepted and deferred challenge set, rationale and consistent next state.
lead_recheck_submission.schema_burden: Identifiers must be unique catalog members and next state must match unresolved work.
lead_recheck_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapper error could falsely unlock Writer, so invalid decisions remain terminal.
lead_recheck_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R5 Lead strict submission succeeded with this profile; R6 made zero Provider attempts.
lead_recheck_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled with max_tokens 8000 for strict mapping only.
lead_recheck_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One Tool Call and zero retry; invalid identifiers or truncation fail closed.

owner_decision_basis: R6 is preserved as a zero-Provider local optional-resume failure. The bounded fix and successor proof restore the exact same five-role plus one Lead frontier without widening scope.
known_boundary: This decision authorizes one fresh R7 content-repair attempt over immutable R5 workpapers after preserving the consumed R6 terminal result. Exactly five role-local analysis and strict-submission pairs plus one Lead pair may use at most twelve Provider calls. No S1/S2, retrieval, external source, Candidate promotion, retry, fallback, Writer, S3 acceptance, generalization, publication or release is authorized. Success still requires independent financial-truth and content reassessment.
